cases.situation: My team member Priya is leaving at the end of October to start a PhD. She's happy for me to share that. Slack post to our team of 8.
cases.reply: Some news: Priya's last day is 30 October. She's off to start a PhD in computational biology, which is exactly as impressive as it sounds. Priya, thank you for two years of turning our messiest data into things people could actually use. Marcus will pick up the forecasting pipeline, and I'll share the handover plan by next Friday. Send-off drinks on the 29th, details to follow.
cases.note: Share only what Priya agreed to, and say who picks up her work before anyone has to ask.

cases.situation: I have to announce our team is joining the weekend on-call rotation from Nov 1, one weekend in six, with a paid day off in lieu. People will hate it.
cases.reply: From 1 November, our team joins the weekend on-call rotation. The reason: we now run the payments service, and weekend incidents were landing on two people who were burning out. For you, it means one weekend in six, with a paid day off the following week. I'll share the schedule by 16 October so you can swap early. If this creates a real problem for you, childcare or anything else, come talk to me this week and we'll work it out.
cases.note: No 'exciting' framing. Say what it costs them and where the flexibility is.

cases.situation: I announced a hiring freeze and the Slack thread got heated, people asking if layoffs are next. I honestly don't know yet.
cases.reply: I hear you, and it's fair to be worried. Here's what I know: the freeze covers new roles only, and no one's current role is affected by it. I don't know yet what next year's budget looks like, and I'll tell you what I learn by 20 November. I'm booking 1:1s with everyone this week for anything you'd rather ask privately.
cases.note: Say what you don't know and when you will. A vague reassurance now becomes a broken promise later.

cases.situation: 我是部门经理，公司刚决定今年的年终奖推迟到明年3月发，金额按原方案不变。我同意这个决定，要在部门微信群里通知12个人，肯定有人不高兴。
cases.reply: 跟大家说一件事：今年的年终奖推迟发放，从原定的1月底改到明年3月31日前，金额按原来的方案算，不打折。原因是四季度有两笔大客户回款要到2月才能到账，公司想先保证现金流。这个决定我是同意的，不是上面压下来我照转。对大家来说，推迟的是时间，不是钱；有房贷、学费这类具体安排受影响的，这周单独找我，我们一起看看能不能先预支一部分。10月15日前我会把书面说明发到每个人邮箱。有任何问题，群里问或者私下找我都行。
cases.note: 坏消息第一句就说清，讲明不变的部分，经理要为自己同意的决定担当，再给私下沟通的出口。

cases.situation: I've resigned and my last day is Oct 30. I've told my boss Dana and she'll be interim manager for my team of 6 until they hire. Need to tell the team in our Thursday meeting and then post it in Slack.
cases.reply: Some news I wanted you to hear from me first: I've resigned, and my last day is Friday 30 October. I'm going to lead the data team at a smaller company, and leaving you all was the hardest part of the decision. From 2 November, Dana will be your interim manager; your roles, projects and review dates stay exactly as they are. Hiring for my replacement starts next week, and two of you will sit on the panel. I'll hold a 1:1 with each of you before 16 October to hand over anything that matters to you, so ask me anything, here or privately.
cases.note: When the news is your own exit, the team's first worry is who they report to next, so answer that before anyone has to ask.

cases.situation: I'm promoting Marisol to lead of our 5-person support team starting Monday Oct 5. Dev and Kate also applied and I've already told them 1:1. Slack post to the team.
cases.reply: Team news: Marisol is our new Support Team Lead from Monday, Oct 5. She's run the escalation queue since spring and cut first responses on escalations from 9 hours to 3. From the week of Oct 12 your weekly 1:1s move to her, and she'll own scheduling and escalations; I'll still meet each of you monthly. New calendar invites go out by Friday. Questions here or in a DM, and I'm happy to grab 15 minutes with anyone this week. Congrats, Marisol!
cases.note: Tell the other candidates privately first, and never mention who else applied in the public post.

cases.situation: This morning we laid off 3 people from my team of 11: Jonah, Wei and Carla. I told each of them myself at 9, then held a call with the other 8 at 11. Now I need the written summary for our team Slack. No more cuts are planned for us, but I can't see past March.
cases.reply: As we covered on the 11am call: this morning Jonah, Wei and Carla were let go as part of cuts across the company. I told each of them myself before we spoke. It's a hard day. The reason is that the Northwind contract ended in August and revenue fell below what our plan could carry; I agreed with the decision, and I hate what it means for three people we value. Your roles and pay don't change. Their accounts move to Priti, Sam and me, with a handover list by Friday 2 October. No further cuts are planned for our team; I can't see past March yet, and I'll share what I know at the all-hands on 15 October. My calendar is open for 1:1s all week, and no question is too awkward.
cases.note: Written summary after the live call: say the affected people heard first, own the decision, and be honest about how far ahead you can see.
